summary: Window title setting is implemented. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Nothing was committed.
